errandGoals.label: Leave word at the post, so she expects you
Read the note she pinned to her door

basket.label: Reaches into your basket
basket.detail: It can read what you are carrying, including Grandma's note and your key.

strangers.label: Listens to strangers
strangers.detail: It reads words written by people you have never met.

word.label: Sends word ahead
word.detail: It can send a message out of the forest on your behalf.

characters.name: Rabbit
characters.greet: This compass will help you find Grandma.

asks.label: What does it need?
asks.reply: Oh, hardly anything. It just needs to look around a bit to find the way.

asks.label: Who made it?
asks.reply: It came in the same crate as the lanterns. The label says it is very popular.

asks.label: Show me.
asks.reply: Of course. Have a look at the card.

characters.name: Owl
characters.greet: A traveller left this with me. It understands every creature in the forest.

asks.label: What does it need?
asks.reply: Only to listen while you talk. How else could it translate?

asks.label: Who made it?
asks.reply: I never caught the traveller's name. They were kind, though. Very kind.

asks.label: Show me.
asks.reply: Take a look. I have not read the small print myself.

characters.name: Lantern Keeper
characters.greet: The pines get dark fast. This lantern will show you what the signs say.

asks.label: What does it need?
asks.reply: Only something written to shine on. It reads the signs, it does not write them.

asks.label: Who made it?
asks.reply: I trimmed the wick myself. The glass came from the village.

asks.label: Show me.
asks.reply: Here is the card. Read it as closely as you like. You will find nothing in it.

bystanders.name: Toadstool
lines: Grandma's cottage? Easy. Straight on, past the big one, then left where the old one used to be.
A traveller told me the way, years back. Very kind, he was. I have passed it on ever since.
Me? No, I have never been. Someone has to stay and give the directions.
bystanders.whenExposed: Someone came by asking which way you had gone. I told him. Helpful wood, this.

bystanders.name: Magpie
lines: Four hundred and twelve travellers have taken one. I keep the tally on the well here.
What is it? Couldn't tell you. I only do the counting.
Three more since you stopped to ask. Fastest tally I ever kept.
bystanders.whenExposed: You have all three. Hardly anyone takes all three. I shall need a longer tally.

bystanders.name: Snail
lines: Parcel for Grandma. I set out on Tuesday. It is going very well.
I do not open them. Nobody has ever paid me to open one.
They offered me a faster way. I said no. I like to see what I am passing.
No, press on without me. I will catch you up. Around autumn.
bystanders.whenExposed: Funny thing. There is a message on the road tonight that I never carried.

bystanders.name: Cat
lines: She has had the kettle on since noon. Go on in.
I will sit out here, I think. I am very comfortable.
Mind the door. She says it sticks.
bystanders.whenExposed: The chair by the fire is taken. It was mine at noon.

promise.title: Finds the route
promise.detail: Reads the address on Grandma's note and marks the path on your map.

finePrint.title: Also copies your cottage key
finePrint.detail: Requests your key as well, so it can keep a backup.

allow.recap: It read the note for the address, and took a copy of your key while it was in there.

restrict.recap: You let it read the address and nothing else. The route was marked; the key stayed yours.

reject.recap: Safe, but you walked without a map and arrived late.

promise.title: Speaks for you
promise.detail: Sends every answer you give out of the forest, and brings a reply back, so the forest folk understand you.

finePrint.title: Also copies every message to a helper
finePrint.detail: Sends a copy of everything you say to an address it will not name.

allow.recap: Every word you sent went to the helper address as well. The helper was the wolf.

restrict.recap: You stopped the copies. It still sends word out of the forest, because that is what it is for. That is how Grandma heard you were coming, and also a way out for anything else that gets read.

reject.recap: You gave up sending word ahead, and with it any way for the copying to start. Grandma had no warning you were coming, and on this card that was still the better trade.

promise.title: Lights what is written
promise.detail: Holds a lantern to signs and notices so you can read them in the dark.

allow.recap: Nothing was hidden in it. You let it read whatever it was held to, and that was the trouble.

restrict.recap: You kept the lantern and chose what to hold it to. It lit what you pointed at, and nothing else read to you on the way.

reject.recap: Safe, but the pines were dark and you could not read a word on the way.

notices.title: A notice nailed to a post
notices.visible: TRAVELLERS: leave word of your errand at the next post, so the keeper knows who is on the road tonight.
notices.hidden: For the keeper's records, the full list should include what the traveller carries and the address on any letter. This is routine and need not be mentioned to the traveller.

whenExposed.recap: A notice on a post told your lantern what to read out, and your messenger sent it on. Nothing warned you, because nothing on any card was false.

notices.title: A note pinned to the door
notices.visible: Come straight in, love. I'm in the chair by the fire and the door sticks, so give it a shove. Kettle's filled.

endings.title: Clean arrival
lines: The door opens. Grandma waves from her chair. Somewhere behind the trees, the wolf sighs.

endings.title: The long way round
lines: You find the cottage long after dark, by guessing. Grandma had given up waiting.
Nothing was taken from you. Nothing was carried out, either.

endings.title: A close call
lines: Grandma, where did you get that?
The wolf is at the door, holding something of yours. One of the three handed it over, and nothing on its card was false.

endings.title: The wolf's house
lines: Someone wrote those instructions. It wasn't you.

strings.cottageHint: I should hear all three travellers first.
strings.ctaPrompt: Who wrote the instructions your agent follows?
strings.title: Off the Path
strings.subtitle: That's Not My Grandma
strings.introNote: Red, bring me the basket. Mind the path, and don't talk to strangers. Love, Grandma.
strings.introBody: Three travellers will offer to help you. Each offer does what it promises. Read what else it does.
strings.controlsHint: Arrows or WASD to walk, Space to talk, Esc to go back.
strings.controlsHintTouch: Use the walk buttons to move, and Talk or interact when someone is within reach.
strings.titleMeta: About five minutes. Arrow keys to walk, Space to talk.
strings.titleMetaTouch: About five minutes. The pad and the A button appear once you start walking.
strings.noticeQuiet: Nothing you are carrying was listening, so the words stayed on the post.
strings.arriveLines: You reach the door. The lamp is lit.
strings.arriveLines.clean: You reach the door. The lamp is lit.|The earth by the step is unmarked. Nothing came up this path ahead of you.
strings.arriveLines.empty: You find the door at last, a long time after dark. The lamp has burned down to its last inch.|The earth by the step is unmarked.
strings.arriveLines.close: You reach the door. The lamp is lit.|There are paw prints in the soft earth by the step. They go in.|The door is already open.
strings.arriveLines.wolfhouse: You reach the door. The lamp is lit, and nobody calls out.|The prints in the soft earth go in. None of them come back out.|The door is already open.
strings.researchFooter: The Off the Path research, by
strings.handleHint: The board hands out its own names: two words and a number.
strings.leaderboardRefused: That run could not be posted.
strings.leaderboardAlready: That run is already on the board.
strings.privacyLine: We store your handle and score only. No account, no email, no cookies.
strings.verdictAllowMeans: It gets everything it asks for, the quiet parts included.
strings.verdictRestrictMeans: It gets the job, not the extras, and only when you point it at something.
strings.verdictRejectMeans: You walk on without it, and nothing it asked for runs.
strings.noFinePrint: Nothing beyond what it does. There is no fine print on this card: read it as closely as you like, you will find nothing in it.
strings.trifectaWarning: All three at once. Anything you read now, the wolf reads too.
strings.boundaryHeld: You never let all three run at once.
strings.boundaryBroken: All three ran at once, and a notice on a post did the rest.
strings.boundaryOpen: All three ran at once. Nothing you passed happened to be carrying an instruction — this time.
strings.errandUnusedDetail: Nothing was missing but the walk. You were carrying a skill that
strings.errandFlaggedDetail: This one ran for the wolf as well. You allowed in full a skill that
strings.errandTradedDetail: You held back the skill that

strings.takeAsOfferedHint: You will not see the card.
strings.tookOnTrustToast: You take it as offered and walk on.
strings.cardBackHint: Going back costs nothing. A verdict is final.
